high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the official James Bond Twitter account (@007). The tweet announces that Steven Knight will be writing the next James Bond film for Amazon MGM Studios. The tweet includes a photo of Steven Knight, who appears to be middle-aged with a beard and mustache, wearing a light blue shirt. He has a pair of glasses hanging from his shirt collar. The tweet is timestamped at 2:31 AM on August 1, 2025. It has received 4.2K likes and 134 replies. The background of the tweet is black with gold text
